lines.en: I crawl sideways across the swamp.

lines.zh: 我的壳上挂着一层水草。
lines.en: Weeds hang from my shell.
I slip with each step.
I climb out of the shallows.
In the swamp, I walk around the shells.
My shell drags a furrow in the mud.
My claws are held before me.
Muddy water drips from my legs.
I walk on the water weeds.
I make a circuit of the swamp edge.
I stop and shake my shell.
I duck back into the reeds.
I walk sideways on wet mud.
When the reeds rustle, I turn.
I angle my shell as I crawl.
My claw taps a stone.
I lie by the water, shell half-sunk.
My claws open and close.
I listen to the swamp.
Bubbles break on the water.
I slowly extend my eye stalks.
My shell is covered in moss.
Half sunk in water, my shell looks like stone.
Weeds drift beside me.
I wait for someone to drink here.
I shake one claw.
The swamp is close and warm.
I sink my body a little more.
Footsteps splash far off.
I draw my claws to my chest.

lines.zh: 水面的波纹告诉我你多重。
lines.en: The ripples tell me your weight.
I peek out from the weeds.

lines.zh: 我的壳挡住了你的视线。
lines.en: My shell blocks your view.

lines.zh: 雾气里，我的壳也看不清。
lines.en: In this mist, even my shell is unclear.
I raise both claws.
The ground under you is soft mud.

lines.zh: 我在浅水里只露出眼睛。
lines.en: Only my eyes show above the shallows.
Your trousers are already wet.
I note the way you came.

lines.zh: 这整片沼泽都是我们的。
lines.en: This whole swamp is ours.
My shell rang from a blow.
I sidle back half a foot.
That hit my leg.
I shrink into the mud.
This wound, my shell can take.
Muddy water fills my shell gaps.
I can still sidle along.
I remember your feet.
The muddy water has red in it.
I raise my claws again.
That smells like something dead.
I sidle toward the smell.
I poke it with a claw.
It's soft; edible.
I take a small taste.
Set it down and I won't chase.
That's less than one grab.
I drag it into the reeds.
Several claws rise from the mud.
I eat slowly under my shell.

lines.zh: 我的壳做成甲，在水里最管用。
lines.en: My shell makes armor that works in water.
I back into the reed shadow.
My shell is hard; don't touch.
My claw blocked you.
Muddy water sprays everywhere.
I press against the trunk.
You nearly crushed my shell.
I retreat deep into the reeds.
My shell scrapes your boot.
I sidle out again.

lines.zh: 另一只壳从芦苇里出来。
lines.en: Another shell comes out of the reeds.
We measure claws against each other.
Its shell is smaller than mine.
We hide together in the mud.
The swamp can feed our brood.

lines.zh: 我们在水草里并排趴着。
lines.en: We lie side by side in the weeds.

lines.zh: 水面只有它的一点波纹。
lines.en: Only a ripple of it shows on the surface.

lines.zh: 我的甲壳，能做成水下铠甲。
lines.en: My shell makes armor that works underwater.
In this moment the mud is warm.
Before the tide, we don't move.
I lift it in a claw and look.
Too hard; I can't crack it.
I stuff it under my shell.
I turn over whatever's in the mud.
It slipped; I grabbed it again.
This is enough for a meal.
I drag it into the reeds.
It's stuck in my claw's teeth.
A fellow tried; I grabbed first.
The rest sinks back into mud.
The water moved over there.

lines.zh: 水边那点动静我盯住了。
lines.en: I've fixed on that stir by the water.
I turn broadside and aim.
It's too close to the mud bank.
I start moving.
My fellows are heading there too.
I fix on the slowest one.
I slip under the weeds.
This shallows is my hunting ground.
The mud slows it down.
I sidle closer step by step.
The mud muffles my sound.
Mud covers my shell.
I hide behind a stone.
My claw tip is nearly on you.
My other claw hides underwater.
It's stepped into soft mud.
I crawl along the reed roots.
I have only this claw to swing.
I raise my claw and wait.
My claw clamps on its foot.
The other claw comes too.
My shell can be made into armor for water.
My shell strikes, heavy.
The muddy water churns.
You can't keep your footing.
I release and back away.
We've flattened the reeds.
I sidle in again.
My claw closes on its leg.
I come up out of the swamp mud.
A string of bubbles breaks the surface.
A Crabbling, out of the reeds.
Water still drips from my shell.
I crawl up onto the shallows.
My claws show first.
My scent is all over here.
I move sideways slowly.
A shadow moves among the weeds.
I stop and raise one claw.
Fire roasts my shell and white steam rises.

lines.zh: 我从石头上摔下，壳翻了。
lines.en: I fall off a stone and my shell flips.

lines.zh: 水漫过我的眼柄，看不见了。
lines.en: Water covers my eye stalks and I can't see.

lines.zh: 爆炸把泥水全掀到我身上。
lines.en: The blast throws mud and water over me.
The arrow lodges in my joint.
The light stiffens my claws.
Too long hungry, my claws are weak.

lines.zh: 雷打在水面上，我整只都麻。
lines.en: Lightning hits the water and numbs me whole.
No mud here to hide in.
